usage: Racing mode emblems for the main menu

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single premium 3D racing-game mode emblem for a dark graphite UI button, readable at 56 pixels. One centered coherent object, fills 84 percent of square image with clean padding. Slight isometric angle, bold beveled geometry, brushed titanium edges and matte graphite body, soft realistic studio light. Fully transparent background with crisp alpha edges. No pedestal, no enclosing rectangular tile, no surrounding scene, no words, no watermark, no surrounding particles. Restrained sophisticated style, not cartoonish. Subject: CLASSIC RUN represented by an endless highway sculpted into a very clear infinity-loop silhouette. The road itself is the whole infinity sign: substantial dark asphalt ribbon with silver beveled shoulders, short pale-lime dashed center markings that follow BOTH loops. Pale-lime (#defb7b) accents and silver highlights. Slight raised crossing in center. Immediately communicates endless driving and continuous progress. Keep the outline thick, simple and legible, no other objects.
